items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: Gordy Bourns says, “When I wear the hat I can’t play the tuba, the tuba hits it.” ... those are justifiable complaints. So what we’ll do... I’ve told them that you don’t have to wear the hats except when we’re being photographed.

ctx.x: And Gordy is a wonderful tuba player. He goes to tuba camp you know, to learn jazz. Jazz tuba camp.
That’s cool. Now the Alumni All-Stars, is there an official first year of their existence?
